SMITHSONIAN INSTITUTION
INTERVIEWS WITH JAZZ MUSICIANS
MARY LOU WILLIAMS
Jazz Oral History Project
Interviewed by John S. Wilson
on 6/26/1973
Let's start from the beginning. When were you born and where?
I was born in Atlanta, Georgia, 1910, 8th of May.
8th of May, 1910. What was your name when you were born?
Mary Louise Scruggs. That was my father's name. I was born out of wedlock.

I met my father. Before I went to Europe I had to go to Atlanta, Georgia, to find out my birth date, because it seems that during the period when I was born they had these - what do they call the women that delivered babies?
Midwives, and my mother didn't really remember my birth date. I couldn't get it in Pittsburgh so I had to go back to Atlanta, Georgia, to try to get it.
And you met your father there?
How did you run into him then?
I have a half-brother in Atlanta, Georgia. He's a school teacher -
Willis Scruggs. He was just a little boy when I was about 2 or 3 years old. He just loved music arou
It was because I had taken the neighborhood on.
This was after, um in Pittsburgh, in East Liberty.
